name: Digitakt
summary: New SRC machines, a slice editor and system diagnostics.

firmware.flash: Send the .syx with Elektron Transfer and confirm on the unit.
firmware.recovery: Hold FUNC while powering on, choose OS UPGRADE and send the stock .syx.

research.label: elekloader
research.note: Device profile, OS file writer and a core with shared hooks, verified in an emulator and on units by the mods’ authors.

research.label: elektron-firmware-tool
research.note: First public documentation of the OS container, SysEx transport and packing.

sdk.toolchain: m68k-elf GCC and binutils for ColdFire, and Modwerk’s .elemod linker and OS writer (in development).

budgets.name: Shared mod memory
budgets.note: DDR 0x47BE0000–0x47C00000 below the audio DMA ring, shared by the core and every mod (public research: elekloader).

budgets.name: Fast SRAM for code
budgets.note: On-chip SRAM tail 0x8000F700–0x80010000 for time-critical code.

budgets.name: SRC machine slots
budgets.note: Machine ids 4–7, added by the core for new SRC machines.
